title: Cable Natural History Museum

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Home school groups, Scouts, and other organizations are always welcome at the Cable Natural History Museum. Whether your group wants to explore our exhibit, plan a field trip about a specific natural history topic, or work on a scout badge, award, or charm; we offer high-quality educational programs for all ages. Pricing is similar to our other field trips. Please call ahead to schedule your group’s visit, even if you don’t require any special programming. We want to make sure that you have the best possible experience! Museum Naturalists are available for off-site experiences as well. Sometimes it’s easier for everyone if we come to you! services.name: Wildlife Outreach Programs
services.desc: Birds of prey are adapted to face the challenges of living in Wisconsin’s Northwoods. Meet live raptors and find out what tools and strategies these birds use to survive and what we can do to help. Choose from the following topics: What do snakes and raptors have in common? They’re carnivores! Meet two animals that have very different ways of eating the same food. Get up close and personal with some reptiles and amphibians, while learning what makes these critters so unique. This program includes two or three live reptiles and amphibians.
